platforms.name: italki
platforms.notes: Flat 15% on regular lessons. Trial lessons: 0% (tutor keeps 100%).

platforms.name: Preply
platforms.notes: Sliding scale: 33% at 0 hours → 18% after 400 hours teaching on Preply. First trial lesson: 100% to Preply (not modeled).

platforms.name: Cambly
platforms.notes: Per-minute pay: $0.17/min (~$10.20/hour). Effective hourly often lower ($5-8) due to gaps between calls.

platforms.name: 51Talk
platforms.notes: Flat hourly pay (employer model) for Filipino teachers — ~PHP 76-104/hour. Not commission-based.

platforms.name: RareJob
platforms.notes: Flat per-class pay (employer model): ~PHP 55/class (~PHP 85-107/hour avg). Not commission-based.

platforms.name: Native Camp
platforms.notes: Flat per-class pay (employer model): ~PHP 51 per 25-min class (~$1.70/class) for Filipino tutors. Not commission-based.

platforms.name: Engoo (formerly Bibo English)
platforms.notes: Flat per-class pay (employer model). Native speakers ≈ $10/hr; non-native (e.g. Filipino tutors) ≈ $1.20 per 25-min class ($2.40/hr). Not commission-based.

tax.self_employment_form: BIR Form 1701 (Annual Income Tax Return) or 1701A (8% gross income option for self-employed under ₱3M)
registration_steps: Register with the BIR (Bureau of Internal Revenue) using Form 1901 — get a TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number) and Certificate of Registration (COR / Form 2303). One-time fee ₱500.
Get an Authority to Print (ATP) for receipts (Form 1906) — required to issue official receipts to clients.

Choose your tax option: (a) Graduated rates above plus 3% percentage tax (or 12% VAT if turnover > ₱3M), or (b) 8% flat rate on gross sales/receipts above ₱250,000 in lieu of percentage tax — simpler for most tutors. Indicate choice on first return of the year.
File quarterly: Form 1701Q (income tax) by 15 May / 15 Aug / 15 Nov, plus Form 2551Q (percentage tax) by 25th day of month following each quarter — unless on 8% option.
File annually: Form 1701 or 1701A by 15 April for the prior calendar year.
Keep books of accounts (registered with BIR) and copies of all official receipts for 10 years.
Local Business Permit (Mayor's Permit) from your city/municipality — annual renewal.
tax.notes: The 8% flat-rate option is the simplest path for most independent tutors. Below ₱250K gross income you owe nothing; above that, 8% of gross — no separate percentage tax, no detailed expense bookkeeping. Choose this on your first quarterly return (Form 1701Q) of the year. Tax year is calendar year (January–December).

background_check.name: NBI Clearance — National Bureau of Investigation
background_check.notes: Standard background check requested by many parents and online ESL platforms. Apply at https://nbi-clearance.com (online) or any NBI satellite office. Fee ₱130 + ₱25 e-payment. Validity 1 year. Many ESL platforms (51Talk, RareJob etc.) require an active NBI clearance for tutor onboarding.

payment_methods.name: GCash
payment_methods.notes: Default mobile wallet — most parents and adult students will pay via GCash. Free between users, instant.

payment_methods.name: Maya (formerly PayMaya)
payment_methods.notes: Second-most-common mobile wallet. Free P2P transfers.

payment_methods.name: InstaPay (bank transfer)
payment_methods.notes: Real-time bank-to-bank transfer. Most banks charge ₱15-25 per transaction.

payment_methods.name: PayPal
payment_methods.notes: Common for international students paying PH-based tutors. ~4.4% + fixed fee on cross-border transactions.

payment_methods.name: Wise
payment_methods.notes: Strong for receiving USD/EUR/GBP from international students with low FX markup.

payment_methods.name: Stripe Link
payment_methods.notes: Stripe is in Beta in the Philippines — verify availability. ~3.9% + ₱15 per transaction.

insurance.notes: Public liability and professional indemnity are uncommon for individual tutors in the Philippines. Recommended for tutors operating from fixed coaching centres or those with student volumes above 20/week. Annual premium ~₱3,000-8,000 for ₱500K-1M cover.
